real_use_case: Verify the exact reference assembly, reference bytes, source, rights state, bundle identity, and primary-autosome contig aliases before E1A normalization.
upstream_status: Project-owned deterministic verifier over a pinned NCBI RefSeq GRCh38.p14 resource contract.
license: Project-owned implementation; reference bytes are not redistributed in this repository. NCBI source-use caveats remain explicit in the Source Registry.
supported_profile: NCBI RefSeq GCF_000001405.40 / GRCh38.p14, primary autosomes 1-22, single-sample germline VCF E1A scope.
resource_budget: O(r+c) time over resource and contig metadata; no reference sequence is loaded by this verifier.
known_issues: Identity verification only. It does not normalize variants, perform calling, validate clinical interpretation, or activate sex chromosomes, mitochondrial DNA, alternate loci, or patches for E1A.
security: Pure mapping and metadata processing with no filesystem, network, subprocess, dynamic code execution, or reference-byte parsing.
disable_path: Do not select this reference profile in an execution profile; no silent fallback to a human-readable reference name is permitted.
